case_title: WELCH, CHESTER VS YORK, ANTONE (DRIVER) et al

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY WELCH, CHESTER AS TO DEFENDANT YORK, ANTONE (DRIVER) CLARKSON, RAVADA (OWNER) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-02-2001 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION FEB-02-2001, OFF CALENDAR
TRIAL RESET TO MAR-21-2001 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PLAINTIFF FILING "DECLARATION OF OBJECTION" TO JUDGE' REFUSAL TO RECUSE...; PUT LETTER IN THE FILE, OBJECTION NOTED FOR THE RECORD.(C/O ATTY)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WELCH, CHESTER IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT YORK, ANTONE (DRIVER) CLARKSON, RAVADA (OWNER) PLAINTIFF' REQUEST THAT COMMISSIONER KAPLAN RECUSE HERSELF IS DENIED. COMMISSIONER KAPLAN STATED THAT SHE DID NOT KNOW ANY OF THE PARTIES OR ANYTHING ABOUT THE FACTS OF THE CASE. PLAINTIFF PROVIDED NO REASON FOR RECUSAL. PROOF OF SERVICE WAIVED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
